meta.name: Zinc sulphate
meta.positioning: Real 2025+ foreign buy-side demand for this Iran-sourced product (verified + de-noised).
meta.note: Thin-to-moderate and concentrated: the only solid named foreign buy-side signals are institutional import tenders (India NFL 2025-26 WSF global tender, verified) plus one decent-fit Poland RFQ (Kantor, go4WorldBusiness); the rest are anonymous masked ExportersIndia leads from India (a net ZnSO4 exporter) = poor fit.
